entries.text: The read_primitives array_length query on Doris now translates to ARRAY_SIZE instead of ARRAY_LENGTH, which Doris rejects with "Can not found function 'ARRAY_LENGTH'". StarRocks keeps ARRAY_LENGTH.
The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.35.0.5 to 30.35.0.6 (fork commit `ef99d3b5a45c`), a verified delivery of the benchbox-sqlglot fork.
